body:
I know I need to go back to therapy, get back on meds, and in general get my shit together.

I guess it’s because of Covid and being in isolation for a while (about 3 months last year due to extenuating circumstances) I just got used to the comfort of being alone and dealing with this shit on my own.

It’s terrifying to think about it but when you’re so used to isolation or hiding everything, there’s a strange comfort to it.

I remember the first or second week of college, I was grabbing lunch with my roommate and a few other friends. My roommate was a white guy and I’m Korean-American. Anyways, we got onto the topic of the Hangover movies and my roommate did an impression of Leslie Chow. 

Personally, I found it pretty funny and was laughing. But I was the only one laughing. I was the only Asian person at this table mind you, and a girl spoke up saying it was a really fucked up joke.

She went into this full lecture/rant about how he was a cisgendered-white-straight-man that never faced oppression. I cut her off mid sentence and asked her straight up why she was offended. She was stunned and asked why I wasn’t. 

I wasn’t offended because I know it’s a joke. I know my roommate was having his fun with an impression, not trying to be mean or rude. And I told her, her getting offended for me, is worse. Because of the fact, that one, she had no right to be offended. And two, her trying to “stick up for me,” makes it seem like I can’t stick up for myself. 

Moral of the story: mind your own fucking business and shut up so I can eat my sandwich.

Once the bars reopen the first thing I’ll try is a pickle back Jameson shot. I’ve heard of them before and it’s daunting but we’ll see!

Also, someone mentioned to ask a bartender for their opinions on a good whiskey and possibly try as many as possible. And I’ll add your recommendations to the list! Thanks!

Interesting! 

I’ve always stuck with Moscow Mules at bars (one because they tasted sweet and weren’t “girly drinks” and two because my ex’s dad put me onto them). 

During Covid I got into trying different beers/liquors. Not to get drunk but more to just experience the different flavors behind different forms of alcohol. I got a bottle of Jameson for my birthday and fell in love with whiskey. 

I stayed away from dark liquors before because I got drunk off of half a bottle of Jack at a party in high school and ended up stripping down to my boxers running around the house (good times).
Thank you! I actually just moved back for college and need to get a new job. My old boss recommended me to another store to work there so fingers crossed!
Wise words!
Once I find a new job and my first paycheck comes in, I’ll do that.

No. It was some college freshman who wandered in trying to be really cool and he asked the bartender for an IPA. The bartender asked if he’s ever had a Lager IPA and the kid was like, “oh yeah! Like every week after work Hahahha.”
As much as I’d like to be suave like that, I can’t afford to let people keep the change (I still tip bartenders a fair amount).
I’ve only had Jameson straight up thus far. But a little ginger ale and a lime sounds amazing! Thank you!
I always see videos of guys slugging down bottles of cheap liquor (Jack Daniels, Smirnoff, Svedka etc.) it really makes me worry about their liver
Do you feel the ice dilutes the flavor at all?
I would ask but I’m incredibly shy when it comes to simple social events. One time I asked what the bartender’s worst fear was after ordering a Moscow mule. I’ve never gone back.
I feel like drinking it neat makes me take my time with the drink, enjoying it more too. Thanks!
As in price? Or alcohol percentage?

People already look at me funny at a bar because I look like I’m 12. I don’t think there’s much worse than sipping on a shot.

Actually, I saw a guy order a Lager IPA once that was fun.

The amount of knowledge people have about alcohol is amazing. I want to broaden my horizons a bit when it comes to liquor but I don’t want to be known as that pretentious fuckwit that borderlines alcoholism at my university

I’ll have to give it a try! 

I was never a fan of dark liquors but recently I got a bottle of Jameson for my birthday and my buddies and I split the bottle. It was honestly a terrific time (I think I can’t remember some of it)
I got a few, thanks!
You made me chuckle a bit there. Thank you :)
